title: config.changed payload v1
description: Audit event of the configuration registry (D-068, owner C0): one change of a parameter's effective value, recorded by scripts/config set, set --default or revert. The change store replays these events to rebuild every override; a revert is a new change, never an edit of history. Repository-level: pr is null.

old.description: The stored value before the change; null when the parameter read its registry default.

new.description: The stored value after the change; null returns the parameter to its registry default.

actor.description: Who changed it: a person or a session.

at.description: When, RFC 3339 UTC from the injected clock (the envelope's occurred_at).

reverts.description: The event_id of the change this one reverts; null otherwise.
